digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The day moved several enabling pieces forward, but tomorrow's focus remains Amazon Connect readiness and a dense, collision-heavy calendar. The dashboard still shows today's checklist as open, so the carry-forward is intentionally conservative.

items.label: Amazon Connect training enrollment went live
items.detail: The course was activated for 859 employees with a September 23 deadline; three terminated employees were excluded, and the pending attorney audience remains on hold for final confirmation.

items.label: Contigo Plan editing access was approved
items.detail: Jean can now edit the Litify Object Access List used for the Contigo Plan.

items.label: A suspicious recruiting email was reported
items.detail: The security system confirmed Jean's report of the message titled "Just finished a great interview."

items.label: Close Amazon Connect UAT blockers and recover the testing pace
items.detail: The call-recording consent issue was fixed and is ready for retest, but voicemail routing, bilingual prompt behavior, group completion, and the move from 12% toward Friday's 80% target still need a consolidated owner and status readout.

items.label: Finalize Amazon Connect direct-calling and Wave 1 scope
items.detail: Legal Leadership still needs to confirm client-facing use, G-28 phone details, and any additional roles. The team also needs to separate Wave 1 requirements from post-launch enhancements and assess the testing, training, documentation, and timeline impact.

items.label: Secure the dedicated Salesforce integration account
items.detail: Confirm whether the non-human production account will be created directly or routed through Halo, including permissions and monitoring, before UAT advances.

items.label: Review the Supabase security alert
items.detail: Confirm the affected project and severity, then assign remediation or document why no immediate action is needed.

items.label: Finish the executive updates deck
items.detail: Complete the requested review and August-completions slide before Friday's executive status update block.

items.label: Lock the Legal Guidance SOP, training path, and knowledge record
items.detail: Confirm the authoritative Contigo SOP, remaining approvals, and training path so the September 15 launch stays protected.

items.label: Clean up the PM operating view
items.detail: Reconcile Asana with Armando's spreadsheet, then document how Toggl capacity will be measured, who owns missing project IDs, and how the data will guide staffing.

items.label: Clear the pending access approvals
items.detail: Decide Sara Rodriguez's Training Agenda access and review Armando's application request in help desk ticket 0033237.

items.label: Reply to Thiago's September 17 reschedule request
items.detail: Confirm whether the Thiago 1:1 can move to Thursday, September 17 while next week's Amazon Connect UAT and go-live work are arranged.

items.label: Clear Nicolas's time adjustment when it arrives
items.detail: Review the missed clock-in adjustment early so payroll follow-up does not linger.

items.label: The Friday Salesforce Program Standup series was canceled
items.detail: Tomorrow's 10:30 AM occurrence now shows canceled, and the organizer said the Executive Status Report and SaltClick reports will be used for Monday's steering-committee program brief.

items.label: Warm and blind transfers remain in the Amazon Connect design
items.detail: The team confirmed that both transfer methods are required. Blind-transfer support needs FirstFire and SaltClick work plus full testing.

items.label: No-selection callers should route to voicemail
items.detail: Instead of disconnecting after repeated IVR prompts, callers who make no selection should reach voicemail and generate a follow-up ticket.

items.label: Astrid's Claude access was approved
items.detail: Sara approved the request so Astrid can use Claude for CoE status updates and documentation.

items.label: 9:30-11:30 AM - People check-ins lead into a UAT conflict
items.detail: Laura and Astrid 1:1s lead into SVC standup; at 11:00 AM, Group 1 UAT overlaps the Thiago 1:1.

items.label: Noon-1:30 PM - Training review overlaps protected work
items.detail: Amazon Connect go-live training and communications review overlaps the noon blocked space, followed by the EPMO end-of-week check-in at 1:00 PM.

items.label: 2:15-5:00 PM - UAT, pipeline, sprint, and executive work collide
items.detail: Group 4 UAT overlaps the project pipeline sync; at 3:00 PM, Group 2 UAT overlaps both the sprint review and executive slide update. Groups 3 and 1 both start at 4:00 PM.
